row.body: The conformance manifest and tests, the DISCLOSE-1 and KERNEL-1 decisions and the kernel split design. REPO-SHAPE-1 (#2444) was built on main meanwhile, so its version prevails and three drafted items are superseded with evidence in docs/handoff/kernel-split.md; Q-KERNEL-modules remains.
